persona.label: CSM
persona.frequency: daily escalations plus backup cover for absent ZMs

goals: Work the cross-zone escalation queue (Auto/Platinum vs Manual/Gold-Silver) and approve/deny/defer
Act with full ZM authority in a zone whose ZM is unavailable (acting-scope backup cascade)
Confirm approved hand-offs actually land with the receiving zone's SE, not just change a status
scopeNote: Cross-Zone Dashboard (role matrix row) is CSM/OH-only (ZM cell is blank). ZM's manual-flag action originates in the ZM's own Ticket List/'Couldn't Assign' queue, outside this module's page boundary, but its effect (the row landing in the CSM queue) is this module's job. Treat flag-origin as boundary-adjacent, not in-scope UI to build here. No mobile surface named for this module (role matrix: web-only rows); receiving SE gets the assignment through normal SE ticket surfacing, not a cross-zone-specific mobile feature.

capabilities.name: Platinum auto-escalation trigger (1h CRITICAL unassigned / 4h to SUBMITTED) populates CSM queue
capabilities.why: no queue population means CSM's day has nothing to work and Platinum SLA breaches silently

capabilities.name: Approve cross-zone (pick target zone + SE) commits the hand-off
capabilities.why: this is the boundary crossing itself; without it approval is just a status flip, ticket never gets covered

capabilities.name: Deny/defer returns ticket to home ZM queue with reason (reverse path)
capabilities.why: no reverse path leaves denied/deferred Platinum tickets orphaned outside both the CSM and home ZM's working queues

capabilities.name: ZM manual flag (reason) pushes Gold/Silver ticket into CSM queue
capabilities.why: without it only Platinum ever reaches CSM; the Gold/Silver manual-escalation promise in the role/tier model goes unmet

capabilities.name: Denied-Platinum re-escalation from home ZM up to Operations Head
capabilities.why: without the second rung, a Platinum ticket denied at CSM level has no further escalation path and stalls at the top of the tier priority it was supposed to guarantee

capabilities.name: 'Acting as Zonal Manager for [Zone]' banner + acted_as_role audit tag on backup actions
capabilities.why: without the visible tag, CSM backup actions are indistinguishable from the ZM's own, breaking accountability and the CSM-share report

capabilities.name: Approved escalation actually delivers to the target-zone SE's worklist (notification/assignment reaches across the zone boundary)
capabilities.why: an 'approved' escalation that never reaches the receiving SE is a fictional hand-off; this is the module's entire reason to exist

capabilities.name: Per-zone '% approvals by CSM this month' report for Operations Head
capabilities.why: without it Ops Head can't see which zones are quietly leaning on CSM backup instead of having a present ZM
